cadence.what: LOW PRIORITY (2026-09-16: the Northeast PI packet is clinics and therapy offices; a roster only moves a bed-based check). State licensed-facility rosters with LICENSED CAPACITY for waiver group homes, residential habilitation, adult day, assisted living, hospice houses. The one Northeast item that moves a current card: NJ DHS/DDD group homes (Special Homes of NJ). Everything else (FL AHCA, IL, IN, DC, TX, CA, MA, RI) is for a future capacity pass
steps: FL: https://quality.healthfinder.fl.gov/Facility-Provider/FacilityLocator -> facility type PPEC (prescribed pediatric extended care), then Assisted Living, then Adult Day Care -> Download/Export with the licensed capacity column; save as FL_ppec.csv, FL_assisted_living.csv, FL_adult_day.csv

NJ (group homes): https://www.nj.gov/humanservices/ddd/ -> licensed community residences / provider search (DHS licenses developmental-disability group homes; the DOH long-term-care file already loaded does not cover them); save as NJ_ddd_homes.csv
IN: https://www.in.gov/fssa/ddrs/ -> BDDS licensed group homes / supervised group living list with capacity; save as IN_group_homes.csv (retires the occupancy-artifact rows)
DC: https://dds.dc.gov/ or https://dchealth.dc.gov/ -> community residence facilities with bed capacity; save as DC_residential.csv (same purpose)
TX: https://www.hhs.texas.gov/providers/long-term-care-providers -> HCSSA directory export; save as TX_hcssa.csv

NY (two files, joined on Facility ID by the loader; the old Adult Care Facility Directory was retired in 2022): beds = https://health.data.ny.gov/api/views/2g9y-7kqm/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD (Health Facility Certification Information; downloads as Health_Facility_Certification_Information*.csv) and addresses = https://health.data.ny.gov/api/views/vn5v-hh5r/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD (Health Facility General Information; downloads as Health_Facility_General_Information*.csv); the copy lines below name them NY_certification.csv / NY_facilities.csv

NJ: hospitals with licensed beds = https://data.nj.gov/api/views/mrzk-zrvp/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD (Acute-Care Facilities; downloads as Acute-Care_Facilities*.csv -> NJ_acute_care.csv). Nursing homes are already covered by the CMS POS file; NJ assisted living / residential has no CSV export (https://healthapps.nj.gov/facilities/fssearch.aspx is a search form), so skip it unless a table is copied by hand

IL: https://dph.illinois.gov/topics-services/health-care-regulation/health-care-facilities -> facility directories (community integrated living arrangements, intermediate care facilities, assisted living); export or copy with the licensed capacity column; save as IL_<type>.csv

RI: https://health.ri.gov/licenses/ -> Health Care Facilities -> the licensed facility list/search; export or copy the table (hospice, assisted living, group homes) with the licensed bed/capacity column; save as RI_<type>.csv
FL: https://quality.healthfinder.fl.gov/Facility-Provider/FacilityLocator -> facility type (Adult Day Care, Assisted Living, Hospice) -> Download; keep the capacity/beds column; save as FL_<type>.csv
ME: https://www.maine.gov/dhhs/dlc -> licensed facilities lists (assisted housing, residential care, group homes) -> export; save as ME_<type>.csv
MO: https://health.mo.gov/safety/showmelongtermcare/ -> facility list with licensed beds (residential care, assisted living, ICF); save as MO_<type>.csv
CO: https://cdphe.colorado.gov/health-facilities -> 'find and compare' facility data download (assisted living, group homes, adult day); save as CO_<type>.csv
Any state: the file needs a facility name, street address, city, zip and a capacity/beds column under any common header; unusual headers are fine, tell Claude and a column map is added
Then build the capacity table with the commands below
